## Acceptance Criteria
- Install @aws-amplify/seed package as dev dependency
- Create amplify/seed/ directory structure
- Set up TypeScript configuration for seed scripts
- Verify npx ampx sandbox seed command works

## Implementation Steps
- cd dashboard && npm install @aws-amplify/seed --save-dev
- mkdir -p amplify/seed/{phases,strategies,utils}
- Create empty seed.ts entry point
- Test basic seed script execution
